meta.name: Sapne Vs Everyone
meta.description:
Two obsessive dreamers collide with the resistance of expectations, morality and each other.

Rated TV-MA · Returning Series · First aired 8 Dec 2023 · India · Language: Hindi · 69 min
Studio: The Viral Fever · Network: YouTube, Prime Video

Complete series. On your server: S1 5/5 | S2 5/5

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Sapne Vs Zimmedari
videos.overview: An honest soul torn between theater and sales, faces a test of character, while Jimmy, takes on a high-stake real estate job. Their destinies bound to collide, expect a tale of ambition, morality, and the relentless pursuit of dreams.

videos.title: Sapne Vs Darr
videos.overview: Prashant is in a riveting pursuit of the lead role, balancing dreams and his mother's battle with cancer. Jimmy's genius impresses, sparking conflict with Shishir. Their stories collide at Property Lords, promising a gripping drama on dreams, ambitions, and tough choices.

videos.title: Sapne Vs Imaandaari
videos.overview: Amid the chaos, Prashant ends up losing one of the most important things in his life - something that brings him immense happiness. On the other hand, Jimmy strikes a deal with Shishir to seek revenge on his Mamaji. Will Prashant and Jimmy emerge victorious against the odds, or will their dreams shatter? Join us for a riveting episode that explores the complexities of honesty and the sacrifices demanded on the journey to success.

videos.title: Sapne Vs Kismat
videos.overview: Jimmy ropes in Prashant to execute his master plan against Mamaji.  A lifeline at work brings hope to Prashant, but his life takes a dark turn with a family crisis. Jimmy plays with fire by manipulating the pieces in his vendetta against Mamaji. The question looms large: What consequences will Jimmy face, when Mamaj uncovers the truth behind Jimmy's scheming deals?

videos.title: Sapne Vs Zamana
videos.overview:
The stakes are higher than ever as Prashant battles against time and destiny to fulfill his dream of becoming the lead actor, all before the clock runs out on his ill mother. Meanwhile, Jimmy goes all out to settle the score against Mamaji with a risky plan that could potentially be his downfall.

Get ready for the finale you've been waiting for - a symphony of ambition, courage, and sapne!

videos.title: Sapna Tootne Ki Aawaaz
videos.overview: A broken dream brings Prashant to Mumbai, while Jimmy makes a bold move against Mama and positions himself as a threat.

videos.title: Hero Kaun?
videos.overview: Prashant faces rejections and a tough workplace choice. Jimmy provocatively escalates his feud with Mama as Toni tries to keep the peace.

videos.title: Chah Teri Mein Raza Meri
videos.overview: A tense family "truce" meeting spirals for Jimmy, while Prashant's long-awaited success is shadowed by a personal blow.

videos.title: The Sales God
videos.overview: Prashant nears a breakthrough, shadowed by his past, while Jimmy sets a calculated plan for power as Toni advances his own agenda.

videos.title: Main Bhagwaan Banunga
videos.overview: A broken dream brings Prashant to Mumbai, while Jimmy makes a bold move against Mama and positions himself as a threat.
